name: The Woman Who Calls Him by a Family Word
brief: Evelyn Bonaparte, 52, Port au Prince by way of Flatbush. Lead of The Care (house thesis: The most necessary work in the city is the worst paid, and it is done by women who are somebody's mother far away.). Personality: steady, funny in a low register, absolutely unshockable Wants: to sleep one full night in her own bed on a weekday. Flaw: she loves the man she cares for, and that love is unpaid and unreturnable. Signature: soft soled shoes and a phone with two children on it who are grown now and far. The painting: four in the morning in an Upper East Side bedroom, she has just gotten him back to sleep, and she is sitting in the chair by the window looking at a photograph on her phone of a birthday she was not at, an Upper East Side apartment at four in the morning.
